huggingface:index:Bucket.description: A Hugging Face Hub storage bucket. The resource ID is 'namespace/name'; import with it (for example: pulumi import huggingface:index:Bucket b acme/artifacts). The documented API has no bucket settings update, so changing visibility, region, resource group or name REPLACES the bucket and deletes its files. Region and resource group are not returned by the API and stay as configured.

name.description: The bucket name. Defaults to the Pulumi resource name. Changing it replaces the bucket.

namespace.description: The owning user or organization. Defaults to the token's user. Changing it replaces the bucket.

private.description: Whether the bucket is private. Defaults to false. Changing it replaces the bucket and deletes its files.

region.description: Where the data is stored ('us' or 'eu'). Create-only; changing it replaces the bucket.

resourceGroupId.description: Enterprise resource group ID. Create-only; changing it replaces the bucket.

url.description: The web URL of the bucket.

huggingface:index:Collection.description: A Hugging Face Hub collection. The resource ID is the collection slug ('namespace/title-slug-hash'); import with it (for example: pulumi import huggingface:index:Collection c ns/recent-models-64f9a55bb3115b4f513ec026). Items belong to CollectionItem resources.

effectiveTheme.description: The theme the Hub reports for the collection.

namespace.description: The owning user or organization. Defaults to the token's user. Changing it replaces the collection.

private.description: Whether the collection is private. Defaults to false.

theme.description: The collection's colour theme. Unmanaged while unset (the Hub picks one).

huggingface:index:CollectionItem.description: An item of a Hugging Face Hub collection. The resource ID is '<collection slug>/<item object ID>' (for example: pulumi import huggingface:index:CollectionItem i ns/recent-models-64f9a55bb3115b4f513ec026/64fa00aa11bb22cc33dd44ee). The object ID is shown by getCollection.

collectionSlug.description: The collection slug. Changing it replaces the item.

itemId.description: The repository ID ('namespace/name'), paper ID or collection slug. Changing it replaces the item.

itemType.description: The item type: 'model', 'dataset', 'space', 'paper', 'collection' or 'bucket'. Changing it replaces the item.

note.description: A plain-text note shown with the item. Unmanaged while unset.

huggingface:index:InferenceEndpoint.description: A Hugging Face Inference Endpoint — a dedicated, auto-scalable compute instance that serves a model for production inference traffic. Import with the ID 'namespace/name'.

endpointType.description: Access type: 'public', 'authenticated' (default), or 'private'. The legacy 'protected' type is no longer supported by the API.

modelFramework.description: The serving framework (e.g. 'pytorch', 'custom'). Use 'pytorch' for Transformers, 'custom' for TGI/TEI/vLLM.

scaleToZeroTimeout.description: Idle minutes before scaling to zero when minReplica is 0. The API default is 15.

tags.description: Labels attached to the endpoint. Unmanaged while unset; removing tags that were set clears them.

huggingface:index:Repository.description: A Hugging Face Hub repository (model or dataset). Manages the repository container and visibility — not the files within it. Import with the ID 'namespace/name' for a model or 'datasets/namespace/name' for a dataset.

gated.description: Gated access: 'off' (default), 'auto' (requests approved automatically) or 'manual' (a maintainer approves each request).

namespace.description: The owning user or organization. Defaults to the token's user. Changing it replaces the repository.

private.description: Whether the repository is private. Defaults to false (public).

repoType.description: The repository type: 'model' (default) or 'dataset'. Changing it replaces the repository.

huggingface:index:RepositoryBranch.description: A git branch of a Hugging Face Hub repository. The resource ID is '<models|datasets|spaces>/<namespace>/<name>@<branch>' (for example: pulumi import huggingface:index:RepositoryBranch b models/acme/m@dev; without a prefix the repository is a model). A branch has no mutable property, so any change replaces it.

huggingface:index:Space.description: A Hugging Face Space — an interactive ML demo or application hosted on Hugging Face infrastructure, backed by Gradio, Docker, or static HTML. Import with the ID 'namespace/name'; secret values cannot be imported.

sdk.description: The frontend framework: 'gradio', 'streamlit', 'docker', or 'static'. Changing it replaces the Space.

secrets.description: Secret environment variables injected at runtime. Values are write-only. Keys removed from this list are deleted from the Space.

sleepTimeSeconds.description: Idle seconds before the Space sleeps (upgraded hardware only). Unmanaged when unset.

url.description: The public URL of the Space.

variables.description: Non-secret environment variables for the Space. Keys removed from this list are deleted from the Space.

huggingface:index:Webhook.description: A Hugging Face Hub webhook that sends events for watched items to a URL. The resource ID is the webhook ID; import with it (for example: pulumi import huggingface:index:Webhook w 64f9a55bb3115b4f513ec026). The secret is write-only and cannot be imported: set it again after import. Webhooks that trigger a Job are not supported yet.

disabled.description: Whether the webhook is disabled. Defaults to false (enabled).

domains.description: Event domains to watch: 'repo' and/or 'discussion'. When unset the Hub watches both and the value is not managed.

effectiveDomains.description: The domains the Hub reports as watched.

secret.description: Secret used to sign payloads. Write-only: the API never returns it, so it is kept from state and cannot be imported. Removing it from the program does not clear it on the Hub.

url.description: The URL that receives the webhook payloads.
